claims.text: Ibuprofen for RA and OA: 1,200 mg to 3,200 mg daily (300 mg four times a day, or 400 mg, 600 mg or 800 mg three or four times a day).
claims.quote: Rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis, including flare-ups of chronic disease: Suggested Dosage: 1,200 mg to 3,200 mg daily (300 mg four times a day, 400 mg, 600 mg or 800 mg three times a day or four times a day).
claims.locator: Dosage and Administration › Rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis

claims.text: Do not exceed 3,200 mg total daily dose.
claims.quote: Do not exceed 3,200 mg total daily dose.

claims.text: CI: asthma, urticaria or allergic-type reactions after aspirin or other NSAIDs.
